prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Chicago for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on your needs (location, age, insurance, whether you definitely want Invisalign or are open to braces). A quick plan:

1) Quick questions so I can give specific names near you
- What Chicago neighborhood or zip code are you in (or are you willing to travel across the city/suburbs)?
- Are you an adult or child/teen?
- Do you already prefer Invisalign over braces, or are you open to either?
- Any insurance or budget constraints?

2) How to find the “best” orthodontist (what to look for)
- Credentials: look for an orthodontist who is a Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) or at least a member of the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO). Board certification indicates higher standards of training and care.
- Experience with your case: ask how many Invisalign/full‑arch braces cases they treat yearly and whether they treat adult cases (if relevant) or complex bites.
- Invisalign status: Invisalign ranks providers (e.g., Diamond, Premier). Higher status means more experience with aligners.
- Technology & techniques: digital scans (iTero), 3D imaging when needed, self‑ligating/ceramic/lingual options if you want alternatives.
- Before & after photos: request examples of cases similar to yours.
- Reviews & reputation: Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, RealSelf, and referrals from friends/dentists.
- Cost & logistics: get a written treatment plan, total cost, payment plans, expected timeline, and details about retainers and follow‑ups.
- Accessibility & emergency care: office hours, appointment availability, and how they handle emergencies.

3) Questions to ask at a consult
- Am I a good candidate for Invisalign versus braces? Why?
- Estimated treatment time and number of visits
- Total cost, what’s included, and payment options
- Who will do the work — the orthodontist or a resident/assistant?
- Can I see before/after photos of cases like mine?
- What retention protocol do you use after treatment?

If you want, give me your zip code or neighborhood and whether you prefer Invisalign — I’ll list 3–5 highly rated orthodontists/clinics in the Chicago area with short notes (credentials, Invisalign status, typical strengths).
